sources.full: Whispers of Fey and Forest - The Tomes of Melchior IX: Feywild Spells

spell.name: Clumping Pollen
entries: A burst of thick pollen fills a 10-foot cube of space centered on a point of your choice within range until the end of your next turn. Until the spell ends, the area is lightly obscured and considered difficult terrain.
Winds of 10 miles an hour or stronger disperse the pollen and end the spell early.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You can create an additional cube centered on a different point when you reach 5th level (2 cubes), 11th level (3 cubes), and 17th level (4 cubes).

spell.name: Eyeshine
entries: The eyes of the target gain a beastly shine for the spell’s duration. Until the spell ends, the target can see in dim light within 60 feet of it as if it were bright light.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You can target an additional creature when you reach 5th level (2 creatures), 11th level (3 creatures), and 17th level (4 creatures).

spell.name: Fairy Dust
entries: You blow a handful of fey dust into a 10-foot cube of space originating from you. Each creature in the cube must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the next attack made against that creature before the end of your next turn has advantage on the attack roll.

components.m: a handful of dust and glitter

spell.name: Gossamer Strand
entries: A rope of woven spider silk appears, with one end in your hand and one end attached to the target. The rope uses the statistics of hemp rope, has a length equal to your distance from the target plus 1 foot, and vanishes when reduced to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.
The rope can be torn from the target with a successful Strength check against your spell save DC.

spell.name: Pixie Bows
entries: Tiny glimmering shortbows appear next to you and each fires an arrow at a target of your choice you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each arrow. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d4} piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage of each arrow increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d4}), 11th level ({@dice 3d4}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Tailwinds
entries: An energizing tailwind blows in a 5-foot wide, 15-foot-long line originating from a space of your choice you can see within range in a direction of your choice. Each creature in the line has its speed increased by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You can create an additional line originating from a different space when you reach 5th level (2 lines), 11th level (3 lines), and 17th level (4 lines).

spell.name: Alluring Porridge
entries: A magical bowl of delicious-looking porridge appears at a point of your choice within range until the end of your next turn. Roll a {@dice d6}. A creature suffers the effect rolled when it consumes the porridge.

When a creature who can see or smell the porridge starts its turn within 20 feet of it, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must move as close as it can to the porridge, and if it moves within reach of the porridge, it must use its action to consume it. The creature will not move into an obviously dangerous hazard, such as a fire or pit, but will provoke attacks of opportunity. A creature immune to the {@condition charmed} condition automatically succeeds on this save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage or causes an extra {@dice 1d8} healing for each slot level above 1st.
